ownership.quote: This restructuring led to the creation of Nebius Group, focusing on infrastructure for artificial intelligence, with approximately over 1,000 former Yandex employees. Yandex N.V. changed its name to Nebius Group N.V.

stage.quote: Nebius Group N.V. Type Public Traded as Nasdaq: NBIS Nasdaq-100 component
stage.note: Nebius is the renamed/restructured successor of Yandex N.V. (Nasdaq: NBIS), which resumed Nasdaq trading in October 2024 after divesting its Russian assets. It is not a startup progressing through priced VC rounds; it raises capital via public-market private placements (e.g. the Dec 2024 $700M placement and Nvidia's announced $2B investment in March 2026).

total_funding_usd.basis: Sum of disclosed post-spinoff capital raises per Wikipedia (sourced to Reuters/CNA/company filings): $700M private placement (Dec 2024) + Nvidia's announced $2B investment (Mar 2026). Excludes the unrelated $1.3B Yandex N.V. IPO proceeds from 2011, which predate the Nebius restructuring, and excludes any public secondary share sales.
total_funding_usd.quote: In December 2024, Nebius raised $700 million through private investors, including Nvidia (which acquired 0.5% of Nebius) and Accel Partners.

last_round.quote: On 11 March 2026, Nvidia announced that it will invest $2 billion in Nebius.

revenue.basis: Company financial results filed with the SEC (Form 6-K, full-year 2025 results), as reported in Wikipedia's infobox.

note: Nebius Group is the Amsterdam-headquartered successor to Yandex N.V. (founded 1997 in Russia, Nasdaq-listed since 2011). After Yandex N.V. sold its Russian assets in July 2024 and renamed to Nebius Group N.V., it repositioned as an AI-infrastructure/GPU cloud company and resumed Nasdaq trading (NBIS) in October 2024. It is loss-making (net income -$446.7M in 2025) despite growing revenue, and has attracted large strategic capital (Nvidia's $2B investment announced March 2026) to fund GPU-cloud buildout.
